top_signals.title: Taiwan’s Lai Urges Democracies to Unite After Trump-Xi Summit
top_signals.summary: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te called on democracies in the region to unite against threats to stability, as the island faces pressure from Beijing and concerns that Donald Trump’s rapprochement with China could come at Taiwan’s expense.

top_signals.title: Why Record Crude Output Can’t Solve America’s Diesel Crisis
top_signals.summary: The United States is producing more crude oil than ever. According to the Energy Information Administration, U.S. crude production is on track to average a record 13.8 million barrels per day in 2026, surpassing the previous record set last year.  Yet diesel prices recently climbed to record highs, while distillate inventories remain unusually low.
